meta.name: Four More Shots Please
meta.description:
Four unapologetically flawed women live, love, blunder and discover what really makes them tick through friendship and tequila in millennial Mumbai.

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 24 Jan 2019 · India · Language: Hindi · 30 min
Studio: Pritish Nandy Communications · Network: Prime Video

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 10/10 | S3 10/10 | S4 7/7

videos.title: Ambitious. Prude. Feminist. Slut.
videos.overview: Damini has a battle to fight with her board of directors and an itch that won't go away. All hinges on the final hearing of a crucial court case which is in Anjana's hands. Anjana has to deal with a new entrant in Arya's life. Siddhi's mother makes Siddhi's marriage resume her personal project. Umang has a confrontation with a sweaty client at work which leaves her mortified. It’s disaster week!

videos.title: Strong Girls Don't Break.
videos.overview: Along with being schooled on feminism and dealing with an irregular cycle, Damini finds herself being surprisingly open with Jeh. Anjana finally meets Varun's new girlfriend and has an allergic reaction to her. Siddhi goes on a blind date set up by her mother that ends in a climactic manner. A gym client can't seem to keep his hands to himself but Umang gives him a lesson he'll never forget.

videos.title: Long Way From Ludhiana.
videos.overview: Umang gets a new private training client who leaves her tongue-tied. Miss VeeVee makes an appearance to help Anjana feel better. Damini gets trolled and has to deal with a new hire at work. Jeh comes to her rescue with a new 'pet' project. Sneha takes a drastic step to get Siddhi in shape. Siddhi makes a new bestie but his idea of being open and free isn't exactly what Siddhi has in mind.

videos.title: Ex Why Zzz
videos.overview: Anjana has her hands full with Amma, Kavya, a toddler birthday party and an inflexible boss. Varun is moving on but can she? Siddhi's got cam-girl on her mind but isn't sure if she can take the next step. Samara and Umang take their work-outs to the next level. Akanksha takes charge and Damini loses control. Can Kutta and Jeh be her salvation?

videos.title: Love Her. Hate Her.
videos.overview: Siddhi and Sneha's strained relationship comes to a head when Sneha gets a nasty surprise at a baby shower. Miss VeeVee is excited for her first 'meet and greet' and Anjana is desperate to rein her in. Umang and Samara take the next big step in their relationship. Damini has a breakdown but the doctor is there with the right medicine.

videos.title: Fuck This Bar.
videos.overview: Flashback to three years ago, when the girls met for the very first time. Things have changed yet remained the same. Memories and nostalgia help the girls take stock of their lives and make certain decisions in their present.

videos.title: Gone Girls.
videos.overview: A surprise birthday, a bonding trip and a music fest-- the girls take on Goa. Old loves, new loves and lost loves are all on the cards. But sometimes too much partying can lead to unintended consequences, especially when you don't remember what exactly happened the night before!

videos.title: Fam-Jam-Wham-Bam
videos.overview: The girls have to deal with what happened the night before. Siddhi is suffering from the MALV syndrome. Anjana isn't quite sure what to do with Arjun. Umang is adrift not knowing where her relationship stands and Damini gets some nasty news that she can't deal with. And to top it all off-- there are those three men to deal with.

videos.title: Reality Bites.
videos.overview: It's Diwali. A new year and new beginnings. Damini and Jeh are sending some good vibrations to the world and the troll story gains traction. Varun meets Arjun for the first time, Mihir has a surprise for Siddhi and Umang has to deal with unexpected visitors. Fireworks aren't the only thing that will be exploding tonight.

videos.title: Dancing on the Edge
videos.overview: When your world spirals out of control, the only thing to do is to hang on as desperately as you can. And that's what Damini, Anjana, Siddhi and Umang need to do. Relationships and friendships are put to the test with decisions to be taken, fires to be put out and fall-outs to be dealt with. All isn't well. All might not end well.

videos.title: Together Forever?
videos.overview: The four girls reunite when a crisis hits one of them and they reconcile in the beautiful city of Istanbul. They make promises of everlasting friendship and catch up on all that has happened in their lives in the past few months. Will they also go back to Truck Bar or will they find another spot to hangout?

videos.title: Love Is A 4-Letter Word.F@#k Lust Hate Loss Fate
videos.overview: Damini is juggling her writer's block and her relationship with Jeh. Anjana has cold feet since Arjun is getting serious about their relationship and dealing with a misogynist senior. Umang chances upon Samara's public breakdown and feels an intense urge to meet her. Siddhi is trying to prove her worth, gets into an interesting repartee with a comedian. Will Anjana and Umang find their closure?

videos.title: Spring Cleaning
videos.overview: True to it's name, this episode is about cleaning and mending old wounds. Umang is trying her best to be Samara's emotional support by putting her together bit by bit. Anjana's senior is now brash with his misogyny which makes her quit her firm. Viju eventually confronts Siddhi about the controversy and Sneha defends her. Damini clears some mental cobwebs and finds the drive to write.

videos.title: Hell Bent!
videos.overview: An episode of determination and grit. Damini finally finishes her book and tries to pitch it to various publishers. Siddhi performs her first stand up with Amit. Anjana meets another lawyer who is her equal in intellect and they strike upon an electrifying chemistry. Umang finally persuades Samara to lift herself up which leads to Samara accepting a certain repressed emotion.

videos.title: Love Is In The Air
videos.overview: While trying to avoid love, the girls fall into a complex cycle of relationships. Varun is seeking solace in Anjana's company, she doesn't know why. Siddhi is taken into Amit's world. A distraught Damini involuntarily ends up seeking her answers from Jeh who comes up with a brilliant plan for her. Is Samara finally coming out of the closet to claim her love or will she still hide?

videos.title: Crossroads
videos.overview: An episode of dilemma and decisions. #Umara has started trending on social media but is Umang's popularity making Samara insecure? Jeh and Damini have hit a sweet spot and are seeing more of each other. But she is in for an unforeseen shock. Siddhi starts seeing a pattern. Anjana is offered to be a part of Shashank's firm. Will she accept the offer despite the slippery slope that she is on?

videos.title: Step Into The Light
videos.overview: The Drama never ends just gets convoluted. Anjana cannot contain her attraction to Shashank and is basking in the thrill of their relationship. Umang and Samara are now a team. Siddhi invites her father for her show. Will that help them resolve their differences? Will Damini be able to control her life this time or will she have to just go with the flow? The episode ends with a sweet surprise.

videos.title: Hooking Up And Breaking Up
videos.overview: When all starts going well, one has to be careful. Samara is taking over the planning and preparations, leaving Umang perturbed. Shashank and Anjana fight it out at work as a formidable team. Will this chemistry transition from professional to personal? Amit wants commitment but does Siddhi want to be anyone’s girlfriend yet? A certain thought leads Damini to Jeh. Will she tell him the truth?

videos.title: Noughts And Crosses
videos.overview: The wedding has begun! But not without complications of the heart. Damini's panic attack makes Warsi invite himself for the wedding. Umang is on the brink of a meltdown with how the wedding has become a media circus. Siddhi has a surprise visitor at Udaipur. Anjana has some truths to face. There are games, dancing, photo shoots, break ups, and a whole lot of chaos.

videos.title: The One
videos.overview: The season finale is an all-emotional roller coaster ride. The girls are finding themselves amidst all the debris of shattered hearts and broken souls. Anjana faces Sushmita's brunt. Siddhi chooses to move away from home but gets a rude shock in the end. Damini has a complication in her pregnancy. Samara and Umang walk down the aisle, but is this wedding too good to be true?

videos.title: Of love, loss and everything in between.
videos.overview: Siddhi bids farewell to Viju in the most beautiful way. Six months pass and her words dry up. Damini is trying very to be a serious journalist and find domestic bliss with Jeh. Anjana finds herself in the middle of Arya's Happy Family fantasy and Umang feels the urge to make her family happy again. Will the impromptu trip to Ludhiana help Umang find a place in her father's heart?

videos.title: Gulaal.
videos.overview: Umang wants to build her own fitness studio. Anjana can't wrap her head around Arya's pre-teen tantrums. Damini is feral and wild, just not with Jeh. Siddhi sees red while trying to be Sneha's armour. A holi party where secrets spill out in nooks and corners, where drunk confessions are made and where an entrepreneur is born. Will the storm calm down when the bhaang wears off the next morning?

videos.title: We are fine.
videos.overview: The aftermath of a high is not always a low. The girls have learnt to deal with all the lemons that life throws at them. Anjana is calmly dealing with Varun being at her house now. Siddhi is the new boss in town. Damini finds herself being challenged and irked. Umang will need some help being honest with her friend. Will they find the perfect place for the fitness studio of her dreams?

videos.title: Sparks fly.
videos.overview: UMAMI fitness studio opens to much fanfare and Umang finally has her own place in the city. Anjana is the unwillingly referee between Varun and Kavya. Damini is not giving Jeh the space that he needs despite making space for him at her house. Siddhi finds herself on stage with a former lover turned adversary. Will she take to the mic and unleash her grief or will she continue bottling it up?

videos.title: Leap of faith.
videos.overview: Samara's fans make Umang's life miserable, but she finds a friend in one of her studio recruits. Siddhi's first show is met with a solitary laugh instead of a roaring applause. Arya loves her parents being under the same roof, flaunts it even. Damini dons the role of a campaign manager with complete zest. Will Jeh understand Damini's priorities? Will Siddhi allow Sneha to make a friend?

videos.title: When love is gone.
videos.overview: Umang and Meher are in a whirlwind of passion but is Umang being the saviour again? Anjana gets rudely reminded that she can't play happy family with a family that is not hers. Damini loses her grip on Jeh, feels lost and pulls him to her, tighter than before. Will she realise that the threads of their relationship are fraying? Will Umang break her own heart or someone else's?

videos.title: Mirror Mirror on the wall.
videos.overview: A thunderstorm is brewing, lightning and all. Jeh moves in but maybe Damini doesn’t want him anymore? Varun wants to go back to Kavya but maybe Anjana is not ready to let him leave her home and heart? Siddhi rebelled against growing up but maybe she will have to? Umang feels like she is back to square one, maybe she needs a new path? Will this grand birthday party save them from the storm?

videos.title: Birthday Bumps.
videos.overview: The sky is different and so is the mood. It’s time to celebrate. Treasure hunts with tiaras, picnics by the lake, some caustic remarks, some hidden secrets spilled out, this is how Siddhi’s 25th birthday is brought in. While there is cake at this birthday, it does not end up leaving a sweet aftertaste. Will the bruised hearts heal each other or will they end up in scabs?

videos.title: Games people play.
videos.overview: The getaway is coming to an end and peace hasn't been restored yet. Siddhi apologises to Sneha and breaks down in Mihir's arms. Umang needs to wrap her head around all her swirling feelings. Anjana is drawn to the happy family that she can finally have. Damini and Dhananjay make a good team. Will Shashank finally let go of his grudge? Will Jeh break his own heart this time to understand Damini's?

videos.title: The good in goodbye.
videos.overview: One needs to say goodbye to the broken pieces. Damini watches Jeh move out of her home and life. Siddhi and Sneha grieve together.Umang breaks down and breaks up. Anjana realizes that she does not need Varun to have her own happy family. Umang’s closures, Siddhi’s airport chase, Damini’s cocoon and Anjana letting go. Will their safe space get demolished? Will the New Year bring in new hope?

videos.title: The Pact
videos.overview: Our season kicks off in Mumbai with Siddhi finally getting hitched. While she feels stuck, the girls help Siddhi realise that someone who has always accepted her as she is, is the 'Right One' for her. Siddhi finally walks down the aisle and amidst the cacophony of the celebrations, the girls find a quiet moment to make a pact with each other.

videos.title: Pact Ke Side Effects
videos.overview: The girls are finally living their pacts. Damini is channeling her defiance into creativity, Anjana is flirting with the idea of romance again, Umang is exploring new dimensions of love, and Siddhi is facing the realities of adult married life.

videos.title: Unappologitically Me
videos.overview: The girls weaves through the personal and professional chaos of their lives. Umang's "third date" with Dubori ends badly, but new sparks fly with Shai. Damini's podcast stirs drama and reconnects her with ex Warsi. Anjana's fling with Rohan brings freedom and fun, while Siddhi's comedy success strains her marriage.

videos.title: Growing Pains
videos.overview: Siddhi's first brand reel turns unexpectedly viral, sparking tension with Mihir and playful chemistry with Ash. Damini juggles podcast chaos, fertility fears, and an unusual bond. Anjana's fling with Rohan heats up, while Umang bonds with investor Shai over shared scars. When Damini discovers Umang's secret link to her ex's girlfriend, emotions flare.

videos.title: Better Than Sex
videos.overview: This episode balances emotional closure, sexual confidence, and pure comedic chaos. Anjana finds maturity and self-assurance. Siddhi owns her sensuality and begins to connect deeper with Ash. Umang explores identity and belonging. Damini faces unresolved emotions around Jeh. The Bangkok arc kicks off as the season's wild, liberating, and transformative journey for all four women.

videos.title: Handle With Care
videos.overview: Siddhi's bold stand-up strains her marriage, while Umang reels from her ex Samara's wedding invite and Shai's refusal to be her plus one. Anjana grows closer to Rohan but faces comic chaos at salsa class. Damini lands a big interview through Jeh, and tension brews when she confronts Ash about his crush on Siddhi.

videos.title: Lost & Found
videos.overview: In Goa, the girls face love and closure. Anjana's surf lessons spark romance, Damini reunites awkwardly with Jeh, and Siddhi breaks down over Mihir. Umang dreads her ex Samara's wedding, leading to tension but also a pact for honesty. At Pride, Umang embraces love and publicly confesses her feelings for Shai. The season ends with the four stronger, freer, and closer than ever.
